sourceTitle: The Believer Not Ashamed of the Gospel
description: "The Believer Not Ashamed of the Gospel" by Edward Hoare is a sermon delivered in the mid-19th century, specifically in 1850, during the Victorian era. This work is a religious discourse that serves as the sixth anniversary sermon of the Church of England Young Men’s Society.
